items.title: 北方的纳努克
items.creator: Robert J. Flaherty
items.note: 公认的纪录片起点，用镜头「重建」因纽特人冰原上的生存方式。
items.noteEn: The acknowledged birthplace of the documentary, reconstructing Inuit life on film.

items.title: 诺斯费拉图
items.creator: F. W. Murnau
items.note: 影子爬上楼梯的默片哥特，吸血鬼电影的原型。
items.noteEn: A shadow crawling up the stairs — the ur-text of vampire cinema.

items.title: 将军号
items.creator: Buster Keaton & Clyde Bruckman
items.note: 实拍的真实火车追逐至今让人手心冒汗，基顿面无表情的「石头脸」把特技喜剧推到顶峰。
items.noteEn: A real locomotive chase that still dazzles — Keaton's stone-faced stunt comedy at its peak.

items.title: 大都会
items.creator: Fritz Lang
items.note: 1927 年的摩天都市寓言，机器人玛丽亚开创银幕科幻造型。
items.noteEn: A 1927 fable of the vertical city and the robot Maria, founding sci-fi imagery.

items.title: 持摄影机的人
items.creator: Dziga Vertov
items.note: 一座城市的一日被剪成纯蒙太奇，摄影机既是主角也是眼睛。
items.noteEn: A day in the city edited as pure montage — the camera itself as hero and eye.

items.title: 西线无战事（1930）
items.en: All Quiet on the Western Front (1930)
items.creator: Lewis Milestone
items.note: 一战战壕里的少年凋零，反战电影的早期丰碑。
items.noteEn: Schoolboys withering in the trenches — an early monument of anti-war cinema.

items.title: 城市之光
items.creator: Charlie Chaplin
items.note: 流浪汉爱上盲女，用无声与配乐写尽最温柔的体面，卓别林喜剧里的一滴泪。
items.noteEn: A tramp's love for a blind flower girl — silent comedy with the gentlest of hearts.

items.title: M就是凶手
items.creator: Fritz Lang
items.note: 以口哨与气球追踪恋童凶手的德国前法典之作，黑帮与警察联手审判。
items.noteEn: A killer hunted by whistle and balloon in pre-Code Germany — mob and police hold court together.

items.title: 摩登时代
items.creator: Charlie Chaplin
items.note: 流水线上拧螺丝的工人被机器吞进齿轮，工业时代最后的伟大默片喜剧。
items.noteEn: A factory worker devoured by the assembly line — the last great comedy of the silent era.

items.title: 白雪公主和七个小矮人
items.en: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
items.creator: Walt Disney
items.note: 世界第一部彩色动画长片，让动画从短片一跃成为影院的正式艺术。
items.noteEn: The first full-length animated feature, lifting cartoons into the cinema's mainstream.

items.title: 乱世佳人
items.creator: Victor Fleming
items.note: 南北战争的硝烟里，斯嘉丽那句「明天又是新的一天」撑起整部南方史诗。
items.noteEn: Scarlett's 'tomorrow is another day' through the ashes of the Civil War South.

items.title: 关山飞渡
items.creator: John Ford
items.note: 一辆驿车穿越 Apache 领地的公路冒险，约翰·韦恩由此登场，西部片语法的奠基作。
items.noteEn: A stagecoach run through Apache country — the ride that built John Wayne and the genre.

items.title: 绿野仙踪
items.creator: Victor Fleming
items.note: 黄砖路上的桃乐茜，彩色宽银幕的奇幻原典。
items.noteEn: Dorothy's yellow-brick odyssey — the ur-text of screen fantasy.

items.title: 幻想曲
items.creator: Walt Disney
items.note: 米老鼠敲响《魔法师的学徒》，把古典音乐画成无叙事的纯视觉诗。
items.noteEn: Mickey as the sorcerer's apprentice — classical music rendered as pure visual poetry.

items.title: 木偶奇遇记
items.creator: Walt Disney
items.note: 说谎就长鼻子的匹诺曹，把「诚实」二字唱进一代人的童年底色。
items.noteEn: A boy whose nose grows when he lies — honesty sung into a generation's childhood.

items.title: 马耳他之鹰
items.creator: John Huston
items.note: 萨姆·斯佩德与一群谎言的猎手，猎物的猎鹰雕像是虚无本身。
items.noteEn: Sam Spade vs. a nest of liars — the falcon statuette turns out to be nothing at all.

items.title: 卡萨布兰卡
items.creator: Michael Curtiz
items.note: 「世界上有那么多城镇，她却走进了我的」——战时爱情与牺牲的永恒范本。
items.noteEn: 'Of all the gin joints in all the towns in all the world' — romance and sacrifice under war.

items.title: 双重赔偿
items.creator: Billy Wilder
items.note: 保险理赔员与蛇蝎美人的杀夫计划，黑色电影蛇蝎美人原型的奠基作。
items.noteEn: An insurance man and a femme fatale plot murder — the archetypal blueprint of noir.

items.title: 我亲爱的克莱明汀
items.creator: John Ford
items.note: 福特把 OK 牧场枪战拍成纪念碑谷下的田园诗，亨利·方达的怀特·厄普克制而悲悯，法律与乡愁各占一半。
items.noteEn: Ford turns the O.K. Corral into a pastoral under Monument Valley; Henry Fonda's Wyatt Earp balances law and longing.

items.title: 夜长梦多
items.creator: Howard Hawks
items.note: 情节本就混沌，鲍嘉与芭考尔的化学反应就是全部逻辑。
items.noteEn: The plot barely matters — Bogart and Bacall's chemistry is the whole logic.

items.title: 漩涡之外
items.creator: Jacques Tourneur
items.note: 过去的女人追着私家侦探不放，黑色电影宿命论的完美缩影。
items.noteEn: The past in a femme fatale won't let a private eye go — noir fatalism in miniature.

items.title: 偷自行车的人
items.creator: Vittorio De Sica
items.note: 失业父亲带着儿子满城找一辆被偷的自行车，新现实主义的眼泪至今未干。
items.noteEn: An unemployed father and son hunt one stolen bicycle — neorealism's tears never dried.

items.title: 红河谷
items.creator: Howard Hawks
items.note: 一场横贯中西部的超长途牛群迁徙，韦恩与克利夫特的养父子冲突把「文明 vs 蛮荒」的张力拉满。
items.noteEn: A monumental cattle drive across the Midwest, powered by the surrogate father-son clash between Wayne and Clift.

items.title: 第三个人
items.creator: Carol Reed
items.note: 战后维也纳的下水道与旋转木马，齐特琴声里藏着最著名的'不存在'第三个人。
items.noteEn: Post-war Vienna's sewers and ferris wheel — a zither score for cinema's most famous absent man.

items.title: 日落大道
items.creator: Billy Wilder
items.note: 过气默片女星用游泳池收留落魄编剧，好莱坞对自己最刻薄的挽歌。
items.noteEn: A faded silent star keeps a hack writer in her pool — Hollywood's cruellest self-elegy.

items.title: 正午
items.creator: Fred Zinnemann
items.note: 即将卸任的警长独自等待四名枪手，钟声倒计时把悬念压进每一分钟。
items.noteEn: A retiring marshal waits alone for four gunmen — a western ticking in real time.

items.title: 雨中曲
items.creator: Gene Kelly & Stanley Donen
items.note: 从默片到有声片的转型闹剧，金·凯利雨中起舞的镜头定义了整个歌舞片类型。
items.noteEn: The silent-to-sound transition as a farce — Gene Kelly's rain dance defines the genre.

items.title: 罗马假日
items.creator: William Wyler
items.note: 公主与记者的一天「私奔」，奥黛丽·赫本以一头短发成了银幕上最亮的光。
items.noteEn: A princess's one-day escape with a reporter — Audrey Hepburn's luminous breakthrough.

items.title: 东京物语
items.creator: Yasujirō Ozu
items.note: 老夫妇进城看望子女却遭冷落，小津用低机位和静默拍出亲情最温柔的残酷。
items.noteEn: Elderly parents visit indifferent children; Ozu's low angles and silence make family love gently cruel.

items.title: 后窗
items.creator: Alfred Hitchcock
items.note: 把偷窥拍成观众的道德困境，整部戏困在一扇窗前的凝视奇观。
items.noteEn: Voyeurism as moral trap — an entire thriller staged inside one window's gaze.

items.title: 大地之歌
items.creator: Satyajit Ray
items.note: 印度乡村孩童阿普的贫苦童年，雷伊的自然主义让第三世界电影登上世界舞台。
items.noteEn: Apu's impoverished rural childhood; Ray's naturalism put Third World cinema on the world stage.

items.title: 夜与雾
items.creator: Alain Resnais
items.note: 彩色的集中营遗址与黑白档案交错，把大屠杀的寒意推进每一帧。
items.noteEn: Color ruins against black-and-white archives — the Holocaust's chill in every frame.

items.title: 杀手
items.creator: Stanley Kubrick
items.note: 赛马场劫案的多线时间回环，库布里克用剪辑把宿命拆成碎片。
items.noteEn: A racetrack heist in nonlinear fragments — Kubrick's editing turns fate into splinters.

items.title: 搜索者
items.creator: John Ford
items.note: 数年追凶穿越西部，约翰·韦恩的种族执念让英雄与怪物合二为一。
items.noteEn: Years of pursuit across the frontier — Wayne's bigotry blurs hero and monster.

items.title: 十二怒汉
items.creator: Sidney Lumet
items.note: 一间屋、十二把椅子、一场关于合理怀疑的陪审团辩论——单场景电影的天花板。
items.noteEn: One room, twelve men, one argument for reasonable doubt — the ceiling of single-set cinema.

items.title: 光荣之路
items.creator: Stanley Kubrick
items.note: 法军将领用士兵性命换取荣誉，军事法庭的荒谬正义。
items.noteEn: Generals court-martial their own men — the absurd justice of war.

items.title: 桂河大桥
items.en: The Bridge on the River Kwai
items.creator: David Lean
items.note: 日军战俘营修桥的道德悖论，大卫·里恩的殖民史诗。
items.noteEn: A bridge built for the enemy — Lean's moral paradox of command.

items.title: 雁南飞
items.creator: Mikhail Kalatozov
items.note: 战争撕裂的恋人，苏联电影首夺金棕榈。
items.noteEn: A war-torn romance — the first Soviet Palme d'Or.

items.title: 第七封印
items.creator: Ingmar Bergman
items.note: 骑士与死神对弈拖延审判，瘟疫时代的人追问上帝为何沉默。
items.noteEn: A knight plays chess with Death; a plague-torn age asks why God is silent.

items.title: 历劫佳人
items.creator: Orson Welles
items.note: 三分钟一镜到底的边境开场，威尔斯用胖警察的丑陋肉身拍尽腐败。
items.noteEn: A legendary three-minute opening take; Welles embodies corruption in one fat cop.

items.title: 迷魂记
items.creator: Alfred Hitchcock
items.note: 螺旋式镜头与痴恋轮回，被影评人奉为电影语言本身的爱情暗面。
items.noteEn: The dolly-zoom spiral of obsession — critics' pick for cinema's own dark love language.

items.title: 西北偏北
items.creator: Alfred Hitchcock
items.note: 被误认身份的好人一路狂奔，从玉米田农药机到总统山攀岩的经典追逐。
items.noteEn: A man mistaken and on the run — crop-duster strafing and Mount Rushmore define the chase.

items.title: 赤胆屠龙
items.creator: Howard Hawks
items.note: 霍克斯写给《正午》的反题：不靠孤独英雄，而靠醉汉、老人与新手各司其职，一起守一座监狱。
items.noteEn: Hawks' answer to High Noon: no lone hero, just a drunk, an old man and a kid holding one jail together.

items.title: 热情似火
items.creator: Billy Wilder
items.note: 逃命的乐手男扮女装混入女子乐团，结尾那句「没有人是完美的」是影史最妙收场。
items.noteEn: Musicians on the run in drag — 'Nobody's perfect' remains one of cinema's greatest punchlines.

items.title: 甜蜜的生活
items.creator: Federico Fellini
items.note: 罗马夜生活的狗仔与明星们，费里尼让「甜蜜生活」变成一具华丽的空壳。
items.noteEn: Paparazzi and starlets in Rome's nightlife — Fellini renders "la dolce vita" a gilded void.

items.title: 惊魂记
items.creator: Alfred Hitchcock
items.note: 浴室戏 78 个机位剪出 45 秒，希区柯克改写恐怖电影语法。
items.noteEn: The 78-shot shower scene rewrote the grammar of screen terror.

items.title: 豪勇七蛟龙
items.creator: John Sturges
items.note: 七名枪手保护墨西哥村庄，翻拍《七武士》的好莱坞西部群像经典。
items.noteEn: Seven gunmen defend a village — Hollywood's star-studded take on Seven Samurai.

items.title: 西区故事
items.creator: Robert Wise & Jerome Robbins
items.note: 罗密欧与朱丽叶搬到纽约街头帮派，把歌舞推上社会冲突的舞台。
items.noteEn: Romeo and Juliet reimagined as New York street gangs — the musical as social tragedy.

items.title: 堤
items.creator: Chris Marker
items.note: 全片几乎由静态照片构成，穿越时空只为一眼爱情。
items.noteEn: A time-travel story told in still photographs, all for a single glance.

items.title: 阿拉伯的劳伦斯
items.creator: David Lean
items.note: 沙漠史诗中一个英国人成为阿拉伯传奇，劳伦斯的自我分裂和沙丘一样辽阔。
items.noteEn: An Englishman becomes an Arab legend in a desert epic; Lawrence's fractured self is vast as the dunes.

items.title: 双虎屠龙
items.en: The Man Who Shot Liberty Valance
items.creator: John Ford
items.note: 「当传说成为事实，就印传说。」福特用近乎舞台化的黑白影像清算西部神话与历史的裂缝。
items.noteEn: When the legend becomes fact, print the legend — Ford's stark black-and-white reckoning with myth versus history.

items.title: 八部半
items.creator: Federico Fellini
items.note: 灵感枯竭的导演在梦与现实之间打转，费里尼把创作焦虑拍成电影自反性的教科书。
items.noteEn: A blocked director floats between dream and reality — Fellini's textbook of cinematic self-reflection.

items.title: 荒野大镖客
items.creator: Sergio Leone
items.note: 无名客挑动两大家族火并，翻拍黑泽明的同时让「通心粉西部片」横空出世。
items.noteEn: A stranger plays two clans against each other — the film that launched the spaghetti western.

items.title: 大闹天宫
items.creator: 万籁鸣
items.note: 上美厂手绘神作，孙悟空的形象自此定格在几代华人的共同记忆里。
items.noteEn: Shanghai Animation Studio's hand-drawn classic that fixed Sun Wukong in a nation's memory.

items.title: 音乐之声
items.creator: Robert Wise
items.note: 修道院见习修女当上七个孩子的家庭教师，阿尔卑斯山上的歌声与自由。
items.noteEn: A postulant governess and seven children — songs of freedom above the Alps.

items.title: 虎口脱险
items.creator: Gérard Oury
items.note: 二战逃亡路上两位法国平民把德军耍得团团转，法式喜剧的国民记忆。
items.noteEn: A WWII cat-and-mouse farce of civilians outwitting the Germans — France's beloved national comedy.

items.title: 黄金三镖客
items.en: The Good, the Bad and the Ugly
items.creator: Sergio Leone
items.note: 三个枪手寻宝的墓地决斗把对峙推向极致，莫里康内配乐与宽银幕的巅峰。
items.noteEn: Three gunmen hunt Confederate gold — a cemetery standoff and Morricone at his peak.

items.title: 独行杀手
items.creator: Jean-Pierre Melville
items.note: 阿兰·德龙的帽檐与风衣，极简到近乎禅意的杀手仪式，无数杀手片的源头。
items.noteEn: Delon's hat and trench coat in a near-silent ritual — the wellspring of every hitman film.

items.title: 2001 太空漫游
items.creator: Stanley Kubrick
items.note: 从猿骨到星童，用极简对白铺陈人类进化的宏大冥想。
items.noteEn: From bone to star-child, a cosmic meditation told with near-silence.

items.title: 西部往事
items.en: Once Upon a Time in the West
items.creator: Sergio Leone
items.note: 铁路时代的来临碾过旧西部，开场 20 分钟无对白的复仇戏却句句是戏。
items.noteEn: Railroads kill the old West — a wordless 20-minute opening that says everything.

items.title: 虎豹小霸王
items.en: Butch Cassidy and the Sundance Kid
items.creator: George Roy Hill
items.note: 两个被追杀的抢匪有说有笑地浪迹天涯，把西部片拍成最潇洒的双人喜剧。
items.noteEn: Two outlaws on the run, laughing all the way — the western as a buddy comedy.

items.title: 日落黄沙
items.creator: Sam Peckinpah
items.note: 把慢镜头枪战拍成血腥芭蕾，墨西哥革命背景下的末日西部，一举重写银幕暴力美学。
items.noteEn: Slow-motion gunfire as blood ballet; an apocalyptic western set against the Mexican Revolution that rewrote screen violence.

items.title: 花村
items.creator: Robert Altman
items.note: 阿尔特曼的反神话西部：淘金小镇从泥泞里长出市井百态，配乐竟是莱昂纳德·科恩的民谣。
items.noteEn: Altman's anti-mythic western — a frontier town built from mud and greed, scored by Leonard Cohen's folk.

items.title: 歌厅
items.creator: Bob Fosse
items.note: 柏林夜总会的纸醉金迷掩盖着纳粹阴影，丽莎·明尼利的表演燃到极致。
items.noteEn: Berlin's decadent cabaret under the Nazi shadow — Liza Minnelli at full blaze.

items.title: 飞向太空
items.creator: Andrei Tarkovsky
items.note: 海洋行星用记忆吞噬船员，塔可夫斯基对太空歌剧的哲学反写。
items.noteEn: A sentient ocean resurrects memories; Tarkovsky's philosophical answer to space opera.

items.title: 教父
items.creator: Francis Ford Coppola
items.note: 家族即系统：忠诚、背叛与权力继承的黑帮史诗，奠定了整个帮派片语法的地基。
items.noteEn: The family as a system: an epic of loyalty, betrayal and succession that built the mafia-film grammar.

items.title: 龙争虎斗
items.creator: Robert Clouse
items.note: 李小龙的好莱坞破冰之作，把功夫带上国际银幕的类型总动员。
items.noteEn: Bruce Lee's Hollywood breakthrough that brought kung fu to the world's screens.

items.title: 驱魔人
items.creator: William Friedkin
items.note: 绿豌豆汤与倒走楼梯，宗教恐怖的天花板之作。
items.noteEn: The benchmark of religious horror, from pea soup to backward stair-walks.

items.title: 漫长的告别
items.creator: Robert Altman
items.note: 把马洛拖进七十年代嬉皮洛杉矶，一只流浪猫与一支口琴的松弛孤独。
items.noteEn: Philip Marlowe lost in '70s LA — a stray cat and a harmonica's easy-going loneliness.

items.title: 唐人街
items.creator: Roman Polanski
items.note: 水权阴谋与乱伦阴影下的黑色侦探史诗，'唐人街'三个字就是全片的注脚。
items.noteEn: A noir detective epic of water rights and incest — 'Chinatown' is the film's entire footnote.

items.title: 教父2
items.creator: Francis Ford Coppola
items.note: 双线交叉剪辑把移民血泪与家族崩塌并置，续集比肩原作的罕见样本。
items.noteEn: Dual timelines braid an immigrant's rise against a family's fall — the rare sequel that rivals the original.

items.title: 德州电锯杀人狂
items.creator: Tobe Hooper
items.note: 链锯与皮脸在德州农场的暴行，粗粝的纪录式惊悚。
items.noteEn: A chainsaw and a face of skin — grindhouse brutality as documentary.

items.title: 热天午后
items.creator: Sidney Lumet
items.note: 阿尔·帕西诺的银行劫案即兴表演，把荒诞现实拍成令人窒息的群像剧。
items.noteEn: Pacino's bank-job improv turns absurd reality into a suffocating ensemble drama.

items.title: 巨蟒与圣杯
items.en: Monty Python and the Holy Grail
items.creator: Terry Gilliam & Terry Jones
items.note: 用椰子壳当马蹄、骑着假马「攻城」的荒诞亚瑟王传奇，英式无厘头的圣杯。
items.noteEn: King Arthur's quest with coconuts for hoofbeats — the holy grail of absurdist British comedy.

items.title: 飞越疯人院
items.en: One Flew Over the Cuckoo's Nest
items.creator: Milos Forman
items.note: 麦克墨菲撞上制度化的疯人院，自由与秩序的角力至今没有结局。
items.noteEn: A free spirit collides with an institution — the contest between freedom and order never ends.

items.title: 命运的捉弄
items.creator: Eldar Ryazanov
items.note: 醉汉被误送进另一座城市同一条街同一号房，俄罗斯除夕夜年年重播的国民爱情喜剧。
items.noteEn: A drunkard wakes in an identical apartment in another city — Russia's New Year's Eve staple.

items.title: 美国哈兰县
items.creator: Barbara Kopple
items.note: 矿工罢工的枪火与歌声，让芭芭拉成为首位捧起奥斯卡纪录长片的女导演。
items.noteEn: Guns and singing in a miners' strike — Kopple became the first woman to win Best Documentary.

items.title: 出租车司机
items.creator: Martin Scorsese
items.note: 越战老兵特拉维斯在午夜纽约的孤独与愤怒，「你在跟我说话吗」成为影史独白。
items.noteEn: Travis's loneliness and rage in a midnight New York; De Niro's "You talkin' to me?" is screen legend.

items.title: 安妮·霍尔
items.creator: Woody Allen
items.note: 把神经质知识分子的爱情拍成打破第四面墙的话痨拼贴画，改写了好莱坞爱情喜剧的语法。
items.noteEn: Neurotic intellectual romance as a wall-breaking collage of gags — rewrote the romantic comedy grammar.

items.title: 星球大战
items.creator: George Lucas
items.note: 用太空歌剧重启好莱坞暑期档，把原力变成世代神话。
items.noteEn: Rebooted the Hollywood blockbuster as space opera, building a generational myth.

items.title: 阴风阵阵
items.creator: Dario Argento
items.note: 芭蕾学院的血色霓虹，阿基多的彩色噩梦。
items.noteEn: A ballet academy bathed in giallo neon — Argento's lurid nightmare.

items.title: 月光光心慌慌
items.creator: John Carpenter
items.note: 迈克·迈尔斯的面具与五音符配乐，开创砍杀片模板。
items.noteEn: The Shape, the mask and the motif — the template of the slasher.

items.title: 异形
items.creator: Ridley Scott
items.note: 把太空船变成屠宰场，让太空恐怖落回脏兮兮的现实。
items.noteEn: Turns a starship into a slaughterhouse, grounding space horror in grime.

items.title: 现代启示录
items.creator: Francis Ford Coppola
items.note: 沿湄公河溯流而上寻找上校，战争是精神崩溃的镜像。
items.noteEn: A river voyage into madness — the Vietnam War as a journey into the self.

items.title: 哪吒闹海
items.creator: 王树忱
items.note: 哪吒剔骨还父的悲壮，被上美厂画成东方的「叛逆即牺牲」。
items.noteEn: Nezha's self-sacrifice drawn as the East's fable of rebellion through sacrifice.

items.title: 潜行者
items.creator: Andrei Tarkovsky
items.note: 穿越「区」的朝圣之旅，把科幻拍成形而上学。
items.noteEn: A pilgrimage through the Zone that turns sci-fi into metaphysics.

items.title: 愤怒的公牛
items.creator: Martin Scorsese
items.note: 拳王拉莫塔的嫉妒与自毁，黑白拳台成为德尼罗自我惩罚的祭坛。
items.noteEn: LaMotta's jealousy and self-destruction; the black-and-white ring is De Niro's altar of self-flagellation.

items.title: 闪灵
items.creator: Stanley Kubrick
items.note: 全景酒店的走廊迷宫与打字机「只工作不玩耍」，库布里克把恐怖拍成几何。
items.noteEn: A maze-hotel and an axe-wielding father — Kubrick's horror of cold geometry.

items.title: 从海底出击
items.creator: Wolfgang Petersen
items.note: U 型潜艇的深水炸弹与幽闭恐惧，德国视角的海战。
items.noteEn: Depth charges and claustrophobia inside a U-boat — war from the German side.

items.title: 银翼杀手
items.creator: Ridley Scott
items.note: 复制人的雨夜哭泣与雨中独白，把黑色侦探放进霓虹的未来洛杉矶。
items.noteEn: Replicants weeping in acid rain — a noir detective dropped into neon-future LA.

items.title: 甘地传
items.creator: Richard Attenborough
items.note: 本·金斯利化身为「圣雄」，非暴力不合作以八十一年的生命写进历史。
items.noteEn: Ben Kingsley becomes the Mahatma; a lifetime of non-violence inscribed on history.

items.title: 日月无光
items.creator: Chris Marker
items.note: 一封没有收件人的影像信，在东京与非洲之间讨论时间、记忆与图像的熵。
items.noteEn: A video letter to no one, meditating on time, memory and the entropy of images.

items.title: 疤面煞星
items.creator: Brian De Palma
items.note: '小个子'的野心直到那句'Say hello to my little friend'，黑帮堕落的巴洛克寓言。
items.noteEn: A little man's greed all the way to 'Say hello to my little friend' — a baroque fable of downfall.

items.title: 莫扎特传
items.creator: Miloš Forman
items.note: 庸才萨列里与天才莫扎特的嫉妒对峙，「上帝选中了莫扎特，却让我在一旁观看」。
items.noteEn: Mediocre Salieri vs divine Mozart — "God chose Mozart, and left me to watch."

items.title: 风之谷
items.en: Nausicaä of the Valley of the Wind
items.creator: Hayao Miyazaki
items.note: 腐海与巨虫的末日生态诗，娜乌西卡是风之谷的救赎。
items.noteEn: An eco-parable of the toxic jungle and the girl who rides the wind.

items.title: 大魔域
items.creator: Wolfgang Petersen
items.note: 男孩从书页进入幻想国，童年在龙与飞行中永续。
items.noteEn: A boy falls into a book's world, where childhood never ends.

items.title: 回到未来
items.creator: Robert Zemeckis
items.note: 德罗宁载着少年穿越 1955，把时间旅行拍成青春喜剧。
items.noteEn: A DeLorean joyride to 1955 that turned time travel into teenage comedy.

items.title: 妙想天开
items.creator: Terry Gilliam
items.note: 官僚反乌托邦的荒诞噩梦，吉列姆的黑色寓言。
items.noteEn: Gilliam's Kafkaesque nightmare of bureaucracy run mad.

items.title: 自己去看
items.creator: Elem Klimov
items.note: 少年目睹游击队村的毁灭，白俄罗斯炼狱的灼眼真实。
items.noteEn: A boy watches his village erased — Soviet cinema's scorching anti-war.

items.title: 警察故事
items.creator: Jackie Chan
items.note: 成龙的搏命肉身喜剧，商场滑梯与巴士跳车戏至今无人敢照搬。
items.noteEn: Jackie Chan's suicidal stunt comedy — the mall slide and bus jump remain unmatched.

items.title: 浩劫
items.creator: Claude Lanzmann
items.note: 九小时零影像资料的采访长卷，只让幸存者与凶手开口，档案都被悬置。
items.noteEn: Nine hours without archival footage — only survivors and perpetrators speak.

items.title: 英雄本色
items.creator: John Woo
items.note: 周润发风衣墨镜的双枪场面开启英雄片潮流，定义了八九十年代香港黑帮浪漫。
items.noteEn: Chow Yun-fat's trench-coat gun ballet launched the heroic-bloodshed wave and defined HK gangster romance.

items.title: 魔幻迷宫
items.creator: Jim Henson
items.note: 吉姆·亨森的木偶迷宫，大卫·鲍伊的紧身裤与妖歌。
items.noteEn: Henson's puppet labyrinth, with David Bowie's Goblin King and songs.

items.title: 野战排
items.creator: Oliver Stone
items.note: 新兵在老兵的善恶两极间撕裂，奥利弗·斯通的越战自传。
items.noteEn: A grunt torn between sergeants of good and evil — Oliver Stone's tour of duty.

items.title: 全金属外壳
items.creator: Stanley Kubrick
items.note: 新兵营的口号到街头狙击手，库布里克拆解战争中的灵魂。
items.noteEn: Boot-camp chants and a Hue sniper — Kubrick strips war to the bone.

items.title: 末代皇帝
items.creator: Bernardo Bertolucci
items.note: 紫禁城实景拍摄，把一个囚徒皇帝的一生拍成东方与西方眼光的对话。
items.noteEn: Shot inside the Forbidden City, a captive emperor's life becomes a dialogue between East and West.

items.title: 公主新娘
items.creator: Rob Reiner
items.note: 真爱与剑术的童话恶作剧，台词被引用到如今。
items.noteEn: A fairy-tale swashbuckler of true love and wit, endlessly quoted.

items.title: 铁面无私
items.creator: Brian De Palma
items.note: 车站婴儿车阶梯枪战致敬《战舰波将金号》，禁酒令年代的黑帮正典。
items.noteEn: The pram-on-the-stairs shootout salutes Battleship Potemkin — a Prohibition-era classic.

items.title: 一条叫旺达的鱼
items.creator: Charles Crichton
items.note: 一伙笨贼为钻石互相背叛，凯文·克莱恩演的「愚蠢至极」骗过所有观众拿下奥斯卡男配。
items.noteEn: Diamond thieves double-crossing each other — Kevin Kline's idiot act won him an Oscar.

items.title: 阿基拉
items.creator: 大友克洋
items.note: 手绘赛博朋克的巅峰，霓虹都市与生物装甲点燃了九十年代全球动画热。
items.noteEn: The peak of hand-drawn cyberpunk, igniting the global anime boom of the nineties.

items.title: 天堂电影院
items.creator: Giuseppe Tornatore
items.note: 胶片与初恋一起被剪辑成回望，结尾那卷亲吻合集是写给电影的情书。
items.noteEn: Film reels and first love spliced into memory; the closing kiss-reel is a love letter to cinema.

items.title: 虎胆龙威
items.creator: John McTiernan
items.note: 把孤胆警探困进摩天楼，用地下室、电梯井与通风管道改写了好莱坞动作片的空间语法。
items.noteEn: Traps a lone cop inside a skyscraper, rewriting the spatial grammar of the Hollywood action film.

items.title: 山水情
items.creator: 特伟
items.note: 水墨动画的绝唱，古琴声里一师一徒，每一帧都是活的山水画。
items.noteEn: The swan song of ink-wash animation — a teacher and pupil bound by the qin's music.

items.title: 萤火虫之墓
items.creator: 高畑勋
items.note: 兄妹在战败后的日本挨饿，反战不是口号，而是每一勺糖水的重量。
items.noteEn: A brother and sister starve in postwar Japan — anti-war made of each spoonful of sugar water.

items.title: 龙猫
items.creator: 宫崎骏
items.note: 把乡愁画成毛茸茸的森林守护神，龙猫巴士载着全世界失眠的孩子回家。
items.noteEn: Nostalgia as a furry forest spirit; the Catbus carries every sleepless child home.

items.title: 死亡诗社
items.creator: Peter Weir
items.note: 「及时行乐」的基廷老师教学生站在课桌上换一种眼光看世界，代价是青春的觉醒与断裂。
items.noteEn: Carpe diem — Keating makes his boys stand on desks to see the world anew, at the cost of their awakening.

items.title: 与狼共舞
items.creator: Kevin Costner
items.note: 一名军官投奔苏族印第安人，第一次真正站到原住民视角的西部史诗。
items.noteEn: A lieutenant goes native among the Sioux — the first great western from their side.

items.title: 好家伙
items.creator: Martin Scorsese
items.note: 推拉镜头与旁白把黑帮日常拍成摇滚乐，叙述者视角的犯罪片圣经。
items.noteEn: Steadicam and voiceover turn gangster life into rock 'n' roll — the narrator's-eye crime bible.

items.title: 牯岭街少年杀人事件
items.creator: Edward Yang
items.note: 近四小时的少年史诗，小四的一刀既刺向爱人，也刺向整个时代的压抑。
items.noteEn: A four-hour youth epic — Xiao Si's knife strikes both his love and the repression of an era.

items.title: 美女与野兽
items.creator: Gary Trousdale, Kirk Wise
items.note: 首部提名奥斯卡最佳影片的动画，把百老汇音乐剧的骨架搬进赛璐珞。
items.noteEn: The first animated film nominated for Best Picture, transplanting Broadway's bones into cel animation.

items.title: 终结者2：审判日
items.creator: James Cameron
items.note: 液态金属 T-1000 是全 CGI 角色的分水岭，动作与悲悯并存，续集片的天花板。
items.noteEn: The liquid-metal T-1000 set the bar for CGI characters; spectacle and melancholy in one sequel.

items.title: 沉默的羔羊
items.creator: Jonathan Demme
items.note: 史达琳与汉尼拔的隔栏对话，让心理惊悚成为横扫五座奥斯卡的经典。
items.noteEn: Clarice's cage-side talks with Hannibal made psychological horror sweep five Oscars.

items.title: 阮玲玉
items.creator: Stanley Kwan
items.note: 戏中戏与史料交织，张曼玉凭阮玲玉拿下柏林银熊，把默片女星的身前身后揉进光影。
items.noteEn: Film-within-film meets archival footage; Maggie Cheung's Berlin-winning turn haunts the silent star.

items.title: 辣手神探
items.creator: John Woo
items.note: 吴宇森英雄片暴力美学的终点站，医院枪战一镜到底的奇观。
items.noteEn: John Woo's heroic-bloodshed crescendo, capped by the legendary single-take hospital shootout.

items.title: 马尔科姆 X
items.creator: Spike Lee
items.note: 从罪犯到民权领袖再到朝圣者，丹泽尔·华盛顿撑起一部黑人觉醒的编年史。
items.noteEn: From convict to civil-rights leader to pilgrim; Denzel carries a chronicle of Black awakening.

items.title: 落水狗
items.creator: Quentin Tarantino
items.note: 一场被提前揭晓的抢劫、六个互不信任的代号者，昆汀处女作即奠定黑色幽默。
items.noteEn: A heist already gone wrong and six distrustful colors — Tarantino's debut set his noir-comic tone.

items.title: 不可饶恕
items.creator: Clint Eastwood
items.note: 退休枪手为赏金重出江湖，伊斯特伍德为整个西部神话亲手写下的挽歌。
items.noteEn: A retired gunman takes one last job — Eastwood's elegy for the western myth.

items.title: 霸王别姬
items.creator: 陈凯歌
items.note: 戏梦人生半个世纪，把京剧国粹、性别与政治悲剧熔进一炉的华语巅峰。
items.noteEn: Half a century of opera, love and political tragedy — the pinnacle of Chinese-language cinema.

items.title: 唐伯虎点秋香
items.creator: 李力持
items.note: 「小强」与「旺财」的梗从这里走向全国，周星驰古装无厘头的最巅峰之一。
items.noteEn: Where the 'Little Qiang' cockroach meme was born — peak costume mo-lei-tau from Stephen Chow.

items.title: 土拨鼠之日
items.creator: Harold Ramis
items.note: 被困在同一天的主角被迫一遍遍重活，直到学会善良——所有时间循环片的祖本。
items.noteEn: A man relives the same day until he learns kindness — the ur-text of every time-loop comedy.

items.title: 辛德勒的名单
items.creator: Steven Spielberg
items.note: 黑白影像里那一点红衣，是人性在灰烬中仍未被抹去的证据。
items.noteEn: A single red coat in a world of black and white — proof that humanity survived the ashes.

items.title: 东成西就
items.creator: 刘镇伟
items.note: 全港顶流明星贺岁反串大乱斗，一本正经地讲最离谱的笑话，港产喜剧的年味担当。
items.noteEn: Every HK star of the era in gender-bending holiday chaos — Lunar New Year comedy at its most unhinged.

items.title: 墓碑镇
items.creator: George P. Cosmatos
items.note: 90 年代最爽快的枪手群像，瓦尔·基默的「医生」霍利迪把每句对白都嚼出了烟与酒的味道。
items.noteEn: The swaggering gunman ensemble of the '90s; Val Kilmer's Doc Holliday chews every line like tobacco and gin.

items.title: 重庆森林
items.creator: 王家卫
items.note: 金城武吃罐头、王菲晃荡的都市失恋絮语，杜可风手持镜头下的香港夜色。
items.noteEn: Expired pineapple cans and midnight sleepwalkers — Wong Kar-wai films urban loneliness sweet and sour.

items.title: 艾德·伍德
items.creator: Tim Burton
items.note: 影史最烂导演的真诚与狂热被伯顿拍成黑白温柔，热爱本身就不输任何天才。
items.noteEn: Burton films the "worst director ever" with black-and-white tenderness — passion alone rivals genius.

items.title: 阿甘正传
items.creator: Robert Zemeckis
items.note: 用一颗纯真的心穿过美国半个世纪的乱流，笨拙本身就是一种幸运。
items.noteEn: Running on innocence through half a century of American chaos — simplicity as luck.

items.title: 篮球梦
items.creator: Steve James
items.note: 七年跟拍两名芝加哥少年的篮球梦，体育纪录片的巅峰与奥斯卡遗珠。
items.noteEn: Seven years tracking two Chicago teens' basketball dreams — the peak, and an Oscar snub, of sports docs.

items.title: 这个杀手不太冷
items.creator: Luc Besson
items.note: 冷面杀手与孤女玛蒂尔达的忘年羁绊，让暴力片里长出最温柔的花。
items.noteEn: A hitman and a twelve-year-old orphan's bond — tenderness blooming inside a violent thriller.

items.title: 低俗小说
items.creator: Quentin Tarantino
items.note: 环形叙事把三个黑色故事拧成一团，台词与配乐成为九零年代流行文化代名词。
items.noteEn: Circular storytelling braids three tales; its dialogue and soundtrack defined '90s pop culture.

items.title: 生死时速
items.creator: Jan de Bont
items.note: 一列不能低于五十英里的公交车，把高概念悬念焊死在轮子上。
items.noteEn: A bus that must stay above fifty — high-concept suspense welded to four wheels.

items.title: 狮子王
items.creator: Roger Allers, Rob Minkoff
items.note: 把《哈姆雷特》放到非洲草原，生死轮回让动画第一次认真地谈代价。
items.noteEn: Hamlet on the savanna — the circle of life made animation talk seriously about cost.

items.title: 肖申克的救赎
items.creator: Frank Darabont
items.note: 希望是好的，也许是世上最好的东西——体制化的温柔反叛。
items.noteEn: Hope is a good thing, maybe the best of things — a gentle rebellion against the system.

items.title: 活着
items.creator: 张艺谋
items.note: 一个家庭在时代洪流里反复失去，活着的意义被逼到只剩「活着」。
items.noteEn: A family stripped of everything by history, until meaning is reduced to survival itself.

items.title: 大话西游之大圣娶亲
items.en: A Chinese Odyssey Part Two: Cinderella
items.creator: 刘镇伟
items.note: 至尊宝那句「一万年」的台词被华人影迷背了大半生，无厘头里藏的是放不下的遗憾。
items.noteEn: The 'ten thousand years' vow that Chinese audiences still quote — absurdist comedy hiding deep regret.

items.title: 爱在黎明破晓前
items.creator: Richard Linklater
items.note: 维也纳的一夜全靠聊天撑起，爱情被还原成最纯粹的交谈与可能性。
items.noteEn: One night of talk in Vienna — romance reduced to pure conversation and possibility.

items.title: 赌城风云
items.creator: Martin Scorsese
items.note: 拉斯维加斯的黄金时代与倾覆，赌场黑帮权力之巅最喧哗的挽歌。
items.noteEn: The rise and fall of Vegas's golden age — the loudest dirge for casino-era power.

items.title: 攻壳机动队
items.creator: 押井守
items.note: 义体人素子的身份之问，是《黑客帝国》哲学与视觉的直接前身。
items.noteEn: Major Kusanagi's identity duel with the Puppet Master, a cyberpunk animation landmark.

items.title: 盗火线
items.creator: Michael Mann
items.note: 德尼罗与帕西诺首度同框的枪战对谈，把警匪片拍成都市悲剧双人舞。
items.noteEn: De Niro and Pacino finally face off — cop and robber as a tragic urban pas de deux.

items.title: 怒火青春
items.creator: Mathieu Kassovitz
items.note: 巴黎郊区三个青年在骚乱夜游荡，黑白影像里「这世界属于你们」满是火药味。
items.noteEn: Three youths roam a riot-torn Paris suburb; "This world belongs to you" rings with gunpowder.

items.title: 情书
items.creator: Shunji Iwai
items.note: 一封寄往天国的信牵出同名同姓的青春往事，雪国的暗恋温柔而悲伤。
items.noteEn: A letter to the dead uncovers a shared name and a buried teenage love.

items.title: 七宗罪
items.creator: David Fincher
items.note: 七宗罪连环凶杀，雨夜城市的下水道里藏着最后一个'愤怒'的盒子。
items.noteEn: A seven-sins killer in a rain-soaked city — the final box holds one last 'wrath'.

items.title: 非常嫌疑犯
items.creator: Bryan Singer
items.note: 凯撒·苏尔的名字在最后一刻改写整个故事，叙事诡计的教科书。
items.noteEn: The name Kaiser Soze rewrites everything at the last minute — a textbook narrative trick.

items.title: 玩具总动员
items.creator: John Lasseter
items.note: 全球首部全 CG 长片，玩具的嫉妒与忠诚定义了皮克斯的情感语法。
items.noteEn: The first all-CG feature; the toys' jealousy and loyalty defined Pixar's emotional grammar.

items.title: 甜蜜蜜
items.creator: 陈可辛
items.note: 邓丽君的歌声串起两个内地移民在香港的十年聚散，华语爱情片的一座高峰。
items.noteEn: Teresa Teng's songs carry a decade of separations and reunions — a peak of Chinese romance.

items.title: 变脸
items.creator: John Woo
items.note: 换脸设定让正邪在两张皮囊里互换，吴宇森的好莱坞巅峰与双雄宿命论。
items.noteEn: Facial transplants swap hero and villain — Woo's Hollywood peak and his fated-duel obsession.

items.title: 千钧一发
items.creator: Andrew Niccol
items.note: 基因决定命运的近未来，「我不给返程留燃料」的逆袭。
items.noteEn: In a gene-sorted future, a 'god-child' proves will outranks DNA.

items.title: 心灵捕手
items.creator: Gus Van Sant
items.note: 天才清洁工与老心理师互相拯救，「这不是你的错」是一场迟到的自我赦免。
items.noteEn: A janitor-genius and his shrink rescue each other; "It's not your fault" becomes a late absolution.

items.title: 花火
items.creator: Takeshi Kitano
items.note: 北野武把暴力剪成顿挫的诗句，把对垂死妻子的温柔画进每一帧。
items.noteEn: Kitano cuts violence into staccato poetry and paints tenderness for a dying wife into every frame.

items.title: 洛城机密
items.creator: Curtis Hanson
items.note: 五十年代洛杉矶的杂志光鲜与警察黑幕，黑色电影的九零年代复兴范本。
items.noteEn: Glossy '50s LA vs. corrupt cops — the blueprint for the '90s neo-noir revival.

items.title: 美丽人生
items.creator: Roberto Benigni
items.note: 父亲用游戏与谎言为儿子守住集中营里的童年，把最残酷的历史讲成最温柔的爱。
items.noteEn: A father turns the Holocaust into a game to protect his son — tragedy told as the gentlest love.

items.title: 未麻的部屋
items.creator: 今敏
items.note: 偶像转型演员的幻象崩塌，虚实剪辑比《黑天鹅》早了十三年。
items.noteEn: An idol's identity collapses in real time — reality-splicing that predates Black Swan by a decade.

items.title: 幽灵公主
items.creator: 宫崎骏
items.note: 森林与铁镇没有对错只有互害，宫崎骏亲手撕掉非黑即白的童话。
items.noteEn: Forest and forge-town with no side entirely right — Miyazaki tearing up black-and-white fairy tales.

items.title: 甲方乙方
items.creator: 冯小刚
items.note: 「好梦一日游」替人圆梦的荒诞生意，冯氏幽默与内地贺岁片的开山之作。
items.noteEn: A company that rents out fantasy lives — the film that launched Feng Xiaogang's New Year comedy tradition.

items.title: 第五元素
items.creator: Luc Besson
items.note: 吕克·贝松的高概念彩色漫画，太空歌剧的欧陆想象。
items.noteEn: Besson's comic-book high concept — a candy-colored European space opera.

items.title: 泰坦尼克号
items.creator: James Cameron
items.note: 杰克与露丝的生死之恋沉入大西洋，也沉进几代人的记忆深处。
items.noteEn: Jack and Rose's doomed love sinks into the Atlantic — and into global memory.

items.title: 中央车站
items.creator: Walter Salles
items.note: 代写书信的老妇与寻父男孩踏上巴西腹地之旅，两个孤独的灵魂彼此缝合。
items.noteEn: A letter-writing old woman and a fatherless boy cross the Brazilian heartland, mending each other.

items.title: 两杆大烟枪
items.en: Lock, Stock and Two Smoking Barrels
items.creator: Guy Ritchie
items.note: 四组人马围绕两把古董枪的多线混剪，盖·里奇把英伦黑帮喜剧拍得眼花缭乱。
items.noteEn: Four gangs collide over two antique guns in a dazzling braid — Ritchie's dazzling calling card.

items.title: 午夜凶铃
items.creator: Hideo Nakata
items.note: 录像带七日诅咒，开启日式心理恐怖的全球浪潮。
items.noteEn: A cursed videotape and seven days — the wave-maker of J-horror.

items.title: 拯救大兵瑞恩
items.creator: Steven Spielberg
items.note: 奥马哈滩头 24 分钟开场，战争片史上最真实的血腥。
items.noteEn: The 24-minute Omaha Beach landing — the most visceral combat ever shot.

items.title: 谋杀绿脚趾
items.creator: Joel & Ethan Coen
items.note: 一个被误认的「督爷」卷进荒唐绑架案，慵懒哲学与白俄罗斯人的邪典狂欢。
items.noteEn: A case of mistaken identity drags a slacker into absurd chaos — the Dude abides.

items.title: 细细的红线
items.creator: Terrence Malick
items.note: 瓜岛战役中的自然独白，马利克的诗化战争。
items.noteEn: Guadalcanal war seen through nature's eye — Malick's lyrical combat.

items.title: 美国丽人
items.creator: Sam Mendes
items.note: 中产郊区的假象被一袋塑料袋和青春期欲望戳破，美国梦的背面是虚无。
items.noteEn: Suburban facades collapse under a drifting plastic bag and teenage desire — the American Dream's hollow reverse.

items.title: 切肤之爱
items.creator: Takashi Miike
items.note: 相亲变酷刑的缓慢窒息，三池崇史把日常撕出血腥。
items.noteEn: A blind-date romance curdles into torture — Miike's surgical shock.

items.title: 搏击俱乐部
items.creator: David Fincher
items.note: 被消费主义规训的失眠者用拳头找回痛感，第一诫：不许谈论搏击俱乐部。
items.noteEn: An insomniac regains feeling through fists; first rule: you do not talk about Fight Club.

items.title: 诺丁山
items.creator: Roger Michell
items.note: 书店老板与大明星的街角爱情，休·格兰特笨拙的真诚让人没法不喜欢。
items.noteEn: A bookseller and a movie star fall in love on a London street corner.

items.title: 钢铁巨人
items.creator: Brad Bird
items.note: 冷战底色里「你选择成为什么样的人」的温柔反问，票房的败笔、影史的遗珠。
items.noteEn: A gentle 'you are who you choose to be' against the Cold War — a flop at release, a canon gem.

items.title: 黑客帝国
items.creator: Lana & Lilly Wachowski
items.note: 子弹时间把功夫与哲学缝进同一帧，让每个观众都开始怀疑眼前的红蓝药丸。
items.noteEn: Bullet time fused kung fu and philosophy into one frame, making us all question the pill.

items.title: 第六感
items.creator: M. Night Shyamalan
items.note: 'I see dead people'后的反转改写全片，儿童心理与鬼故事温柔相遇。
items.noteEn: The twist behind 'I see dead people' rewrites the film — a gentle ghost story of a boy's pain.

items.title: 卧虎藏龙
items.creator: Ang Lee
items.note: 飞檐走壁的武侠想像配西方古典乐，让东方侠义美学拿下奥斯卡外语片。
items.noteEn: Wire-fu wuxia romance set to Western classical music, winning the Oscar for foreign film.

items.title: 角斗士
items.creator: Ridley Scott
items.note: 古罗马角斗场的复仇史诗，罗素·克劳用剑与泪重振了剑与凉鞋类型。
items.noteEn: A Roman revenge epic that revived the sword-and-sandal genre with Russell Crowe's sword and tears.

items.title: 花样年华
items.creator: 王家卫
items.note: 旗袍与领带在走廊里反复错过，一段婚外情被拍成东方美学的极致暧昧。
items.noteEn: Cheongsam and tie brush past in a corridor — infidelity refined into pure style and longing.

items.title: 西西里的美丽传说
items.creator: Giuseppe Tornatore
items.note: 少年眼中风韵迷人的玛莲娜，是青春期欲望与小镇流言的残酷寓言。
items.noteEn: A boy's obsession with the beautiful Malèna — desire and rumor in a small Sicilian town.

items.title: 记忆碎片
items.creator: Christopher Nolan
items.note: 倒叙剪辑模拟失忆者的时间感，纹身是记忆也是自我欺骗。
items.noteEn: Backward editing mimics a man with no short-term memory — tattoos as memory and self-deceit.

items.title: 偷拐抢骗
items.creator: Guy Ritchie
items.note: 伦敦底层各色人等的钻石与拳赛闹剧，多线剪辑的英伦痞气范本。
items.noteEn: A diamond, a bare-knuckle fight and London's underworld — British cheek in braided timelines.

items.title: 一一
items.creator: Edward Yang
items.note: 婚礼、怀孕、葬礼串联三代人的中年困局，「我们是不是只能看到一半的事情？」
items.noteEn: Wedding, birth and funeral braid three generations; "Can we only see half of things?"

items.title: 天使爱美丽
items.creator: Jean-Pierre Jeunet
items.note: 巴黎女孩用一连串恶作剧式的善举点亮他人的生活，把平凡日子过成了童话。
items.noteEn: A Parisian girl quietly rewrites strangers' lives with whimsical acts of kindness.

items.title: 哈利·波特与魔法石
items.en: Harry Potter and the Sorcerer's Stone
items.creator: Chris Columbus
items.note: 魔法石开启霍格沃茨世界，全球孩子的共同童年。
items.noteEn: Hogwarts opens its doors — the shared childhood of a generation.

items.title: 穆赫兰道
items.creator: David Lynch
items.note: 梦与好莱坞的两半拼图，林奇把失落与欲望拼成无法合拢的蓝盒子。
items.noteEn: Hollywood dream and nightmare in two halves — Lynch's blue box never quite closes.

items.title: 指环王：护戒使者
items.en: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring
items.creator: Peter Jackson
items.note: 中土远征的开端，从夏尔到摩瑞亚的史诗行旅。
items.noteEn: The quest begins — from the Shire to Moria, an epic journey into myth.

items.title: 迁徙的鸟
items.creator: Jacques Perrin
items.note: 与鸟群并肩飞行的航拍，三年跟拍只为一帧擦过翅膀的呼吸。
items.noteEn: Flying wing-to-wing with migratory birds — three years of shooting for one brush of a wing.

items.title: 科伦拜校园事件
items.creator: Michael Moore
items.note: 从校园枪击一路追问美国的枪支文化，把纪录片变成一次社会手术。
items.noteEn: From a school shooting to America's gun culture — documentary as social surgery.

items.title: 猫鼠游戏
items.creator: Steven Spielberg
items.note: 少年骗子与追捕他的探员之间奇妙的亦敌亦友，莱昂纳多把谎言演得闪闪发光。
items.noteEn: A teen con artist and the agent chasing him — an odd friendship where DiCaprio makes lies shine.

items.title: 芝加哥
items.creator: Rob Marshall
items.note: 爵士时代的谋杀与名利场，监狱探戈和「All That Jazz」把罪恶跳成了欢场。
items.noteEn: Murder as entertainment in Jazz Age Chicago — prison tango and all that jazz.

items.title: 上帝之城
items.creator: Fernando Meirelles
items.note: 里约贫民窟的孩子在枪口下长大，快剪与狂欢把暴力拍成一部残酷青春史诗。
items.noteEn: Kids grow up at gunpoint in a Rio favela — frenzied editing turns violence into a brutal youth epic.

items.title: 弗里达
items.creator: Julie Taymor
items.note: 弗里达·卡罗把疼痛画成画布上的自画像，萨玛·海耶克让生命开成不凋的花。
items.noteEn: Kahlo's pain blooms as self-portraits; Salma Hayek makes a life that refuses to wilt.

items.title: 英雄
items.creator: 张艺谋
items.note: 以色彩分章的刺客寓言，把书法、古琴与天下观熔进武侠的骨血。
items.noteEn: A color-coded assassin fable folding calligraphy, zither and 'all under heaven' into wuxia.

items.title: 无间道
items.creator: 刘伟强 / 麦兆辉
items.note: 卧底与黑警的双面人生，港片巅峰的细腻剪辑后来被好莱坞直接翻拍。
items.noteEn: A cop in the mob, a mole in the police — HK's taut duel that Hollywood later remade.

items.title: 咒怨
items.creator: Takashi Shimizu
items.note: 怨念盘踞老宅，伽椰子的爬梯声成为都市噩梦。
items.noteEn: A curse that lives in a house — Kayako's crawl-scratch haunts a decade.

items.title: 指环王：双塔奇兵
items.en: The Lord of the Rings: The Two Towers
items.creator: Peter Jackson
items.note: 圣盔谷一夜守城战，树人与咕噜的双线暗涌。
items.noteEn: Helm's Deep under siege, while Gollum and the Ents shift the tide.

items.title: 钢琴家
items.creator: Roman Polanski
items.note: 波兰钢琴家席皮尔曼在华沙废墟中求生，钢琴声是文明最后的余温。
items.noteEn: Szpilman survives among Warsaw's ruins; music is civilization's last warmth.

items.title: 蔷花，红莲
items.creator: Kim Jee-woon
items.note: 韩式心理恐怖杰作，姐妹与继母的镜像纠葛。
items.noteEn: A masterpiece of Korean psychological horror, a mirror-maze of family grief.

items.title: 海底总动员
items.creator: Andrew Stanton
items.note: 用横跨大洋的寻子冒险讲一个父亲的放手，每一帧海水都在呼吸。
items.noteEn: An ocean-wide quest about a father letting go — every frame of water seems to breathe.

items.title: 杀死比尔1
items.creator: Quentin Tarantino
items.note: 血溅五尺的武士刀与黄黑连体衣，昆汀写给邵氏与日本剑戟片的情书。
items.noteEn: Samurai blades, geysers of blood and the yellow jumpsuit — Tarantino's love letter to Shaw Brothers and chanbara.

items.title: 杀人回忆
items.creator: Bong Joon-ho
items.note: 改编自华城连环案的乡野追凶，在时代之踵里看见荒诞与无力。
items.noteEn: Rural detectives chase Korea's first serial killer — absurdity and helplessness inside a time of trauma.

items.title: 老男孩
items.creator: Park Chan-wook
items.note: 被囚禁十五年的男人走出密室，走廊群殴与生吃章鱼都是复仇的仪式。
items.noteEn: Fifteen years locked in a room — the corridor brawl and live octopus are rituals of revenge.

items.title: 战争迷雾
items.creator: Errol Morris
items.note: 麦克纳马拉的十一条经验，让决策者的愧疚像迷雾一样弥漫开来。
items.noteEn: McNamara's eleven lessons — a decision-maker's remorse spreading like fog.

items.title: 指环王：王者无敌
items.en: The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King
items.creator: Peter Jackson
items.note: 九人护戒团终结于末日火山，奥斯卡横扫 11 项。
items.noteEn: The quest ends at Mount Doom in a sweep of eleven Oscars.

items.title: 疯狂约会美丽都
items.creator: Sylvain Chomet
items.note: 法国式怪诞：老太太、胖狗与三轮车闯进大都会，几乎整片没有对白。
items.noteEn: French whimsy — a grandmother, a fat dog and a bicycle plunge into a metropolis, almost wordlessly.

items.title: 铁西区
items.creator: 王兵
items.note: 九小时纪录沈阳铁西区的工厂与失业，中国独立纪录片的纪念碑。
items.noteEn: Nine hours on Shenyang's Tiexi district and its lost factory jobs — a monument of Chinese indie documentary.

items.title: 帝国的毁灭
items.creator: Oliver Hirschbiegel
items.note: 地堡里希特勒的最后十二天，布鲁诺·甘茨让元首褪去神话、露出人的颤抖。
items.noteEn: Hitler's last twelve days in the bunker — Ganz strips the Führer of myth, leaving human tremor.

items.title: 暖暖内含光
items.en: Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind
items.creator: Michel Gondry
items.note: 把一段爱情从记忆里逐格删除时，才看见自己有多舍不得——科幻外壳下的心碎寓言。
items.noteEn: Deleting a love memory by memory reveals how much you wanted to keep it — a heartbreak dressed as sci-fi.

items.title: 华氏911
items.creator: Michael Moore
items.note: 首部拿下戛纳金棕榈的纪录片，直刺伊拉克战争与媒体合谋。
items.noteEn: The first documentary to win the Palme d'Or, aimed at the Iraq war and media complicity.

items.title: 哈尔的移动城堡
items.creator: Hayao Miyazaki
items.note: 宫崎骏用移动城堡解构战争与衰老，苏菲的勇气是魔法。
items.noteEn: Miyazaki's walking castle against war and age — Sophie's magic is courage.

items.title: 功夫
items.creator: 周星驰
items.note: 把武侠、漫画与特效熔成一场草根逆袭的热血狂欢，金像奖最佳影片证明了它的成色。
items.noteEn: Stephen Chow fuses kung fu, comics and CGI into a riotous underdog fantasy that swept the HK Film Awards.

items.title: 放牛班的春天
items.creator: Christophe Barratier
items.note: 失意音乐老师用合唱团点亮问题少年，「池塘之底」的春天由歌声救赎。
items.noteEn: A teacher's choir transforms troubled boys — music as redemption for the lost.

items.title: 灵魂歌王
items.creator: Taylor Hackford
items.note: 杰米·福克斯还原盲眼歌王雷·查尔斯，蓝调与福音在他的生命里打架又和解。
items.noteEn: Jamie Foxx channels blind Ray Charles — blues and gospel fight and reconcile inside him.

items.title: 飞行家
items.creator: Martin Scorsese
items.note: 霍华德·休斯的飞机制造、好莱坞情史与强迫症，小李子在洁癖里演尽天才的疯狂。
items.noteEn: Hughes's planes, loves and OCD — DiCaprio turns obsession into the price of genius.

items.title: 超人总动员
items.creator: Brad Bird
items.note: 中年危机的超级英雄一家，动作场面是动画界的谍战巅峰。
items.noteEn: Superheroes with a midlife crisis — action staging that rivals live-action spy films.

items.title: 摩托日记
items.creator: Walter Salles
items.note: 年轻的切·格瓦拉骑摩托穿越拉美大陆，沿途的贫穷把医学生变成革命者。
items.noteEn: Young Che rides a motorcycle across Latin America; poverty turns a med student into a revolutionary.

items.title: 恋恋笔记本
items.creator: Nick Cassavetes
items.note: 养老院里每天重读的信，把一生一次的爱情讲给遗忘听。
items.noteEn: A love story read aloud to a fading memory — one lifetime, one true love.

items.title: 歌剧魅影
items.creator: Joel Schumacher
items.note: 地下歌剧院的魅影与克里斯汀，韦伯音乐剧被搬上银幕的华丽版本。
items.noteEn: The Phantom beneath the Paris opera house — Webber's musical brought to lush life.

items.title: 甜蜜的人生
items.creator: Kim Jee-woon
items.note: 向老板的女人多看一眼就万劫不复，金知云的风格化暴力与宿命美学。
items.noteEn: One glance at the boss's girl seals a stylish doom — Kim Jee-woon's stylized violence.

items.title: 追凶
items.creator: Rian Johnson
items.note: 把黑色电影对白塞进高中校园，少年侦探在储物柜间追查毒品谜案。
items.noteEn: Hard-boiled dialogue transplanted to high school — a teen detective hunts through lockers.

items.title: 断背山
items.creator: Ang Lee
items.note: 两个牛仔二十年压抑的深情，李安拍出了克制到极致的遗憾与思念。
items.noteEn: Two cowboys hide a lifetime on Brokeback Mountain; Ang Lee films regret as vast as the range.

items.title: 灰熊人
items.creator: Werner Herzog
items.note: 与灰熊共处十三年的提摩西，赫尔佐格在自恋里读出人性的深渊。
items.noteEn: Thirteen years among grizzlies — Herzog finds the human abyss inside self-delusion.

items.title: 帝企鹅日记
items.creator: Luc Jacquet
items.note: 帝企鹅在极寒里接力孵蛋，把动物行为拍成一部生存主义的史诗。
items.noteEn: Emperor penguins hatching eggs in polar cold — animal behavior as survivalist epic.

items.title: 傲慢与偏见
items.creator: Joe Wright
items.note: 达西先生清晨雾中走来的告白，把简·奥斯汀的机锋拍得又冷又烫。
items.noteEn: Mr. Darcy walking through the dawn mist — Austen's wit made cinematic and warm.

items.title: 罪恶之城
items.creator: Robert Rodriguez / Frank Miller
items.note: 把漫画分镜直接搬上银幕的黑白高反差，雨滴与血珠都颗粒分明。
items.noteEn: Comic panels brought to screen in stark black and white — every raindrop and blood bead visible.

items.title: 与歌同行
items.creator: James Mangold
items.note: 约翰尼·卡什的毒瘾与救赎，瑞茜·威瑟斯彭的琼·卡特让乡村音乐有了灵魂。
items.noteEn: Cash's addiction and redemption; Witherspoon's June Carter gives country music its soul.

items.title: 难以忽视的真相
items.creator: Davis Guggenheim
items.note: 戈尔用一屏图表把全球变暖讲成最急迫、也最反高潮的幻灯片。
items.noteEn: Al Gore turns climate change into the most urgent — and least dramatic — slideshow ever.

items.title: 波拉特
items.creator: Larry Charles
items.note: 哈萨克记者闯荡美国的伪纪录片，用一路冒犯测试西方社会的每一根神经。
items.noteEn: A mockumentary provocation that tests America's tolerance with total impunity.

items.title: 人类之子
items.creator: Alfonso Cuarón
items.note: 一镜到底的逃亡长镜，末世废墟里诞生的唯一婴儿。
items.noteEn: A one-shot war-zone escape and the last baby born into a sterile future.

items.title: 疯狂的石头
items.creator: 宁浩
items.note: 一块翡翠引来的多线混战，小成本黑色喜剧让「石头」成了内地喜剧的新标杆。
items.noteEn: A jade stone ignites a multi-strand scramble — the low-budget hit that rebooted mainland comedy.

items.title: 硫磺岛来信
items.creator: Clint Eastwood
items.note: 从日方视角写硫磺岛，战争双方都并非英雄。
items.noteEn: Iwo Jima from the Japanese side — no heroes, only soldiers.

items.title: 潘神的迷宫
items.creator: Guillermo del Toro
items.note: 法西斯阴影下小女孩的黑暗童话，现实与幻境互噬。
items.noteEn: A dark fairy tale under Franco's shadow where reality and fable devour each other.

items.title: 红辣椒
items.creator: 今敏
items.note: 梦境治疗仪让整座东京做同一个梦，是《盗梦空间》的视觉先声。
items.noteEn: A dream machine makes Tokyo share one dream — Inception's visual ancestor.

items.title: 地球脉动
items.creator: Alastair Fothergill
items.note: 高空航拍与微距并列，BBC 把自然纪录片推上电影级的影像高度。
items.noteEn: Aerial and macro side by side — BBC pushed nature documentary to cinematic heights.

items.title: 无间道风云
items.creator: Martin Scorsese
items.note: 波士顿警匪双面卧底，双线绞杀让老马丁终于捧起最佳影片小金人。
items.noteEn: Two moles at war in Boston — the double-agent duel that finally won Scorsese his Best Picture.

items.title: 窃听风暴
items.creator: Florian Henckel von Donnersmarck
items.note: 东德秘密警察从监听者变成守护者，一个人的良知照亮了整部极权机器。
items.noteEn: A Stasi agent turns from listener to guardian — one conscience lights up an entire apparatus.

items.title: 致命魔术
items.creator: Christopher Nolan
items.note: 两个魔术师以命相博的骗局，电影本身就是最大的障眼法。
items.noteEn: Two magicians destroying each other for one trick — the film itself is the ultimate misdirection.

items.title: 当幸福来敲门
items.creator: Gabriele Muccino
items.note: 睡在厕所也要抱着儿子的单亲爸爸，史密斯父子的真实出演让励志有了体温。
items.noteEn: A homeless dad sleeps in a subway restroom with his son; father-and-son casting makes it warm.

items.title: 玫瑰人生
items.creator: Olivier Dahan
items.note: 玛丽昂·歌迪亚化身为法国小云雀皮雅芙，玫瑰色的人生也是荆棘满身的一生。
items.noteEn: Cotillard becomes the Little Sparrow Piaf — a life in roses, thorned through and through.

items.title: 老无所依
items.creator: Joel & Ethan Coen
items.note: 冷面杀手用硬币决定生死，老警长输给了时代——恶不再需要理由。
items.noteEn: A coin flip decides life and death; the old sheriff loses to an age where evil needs no reason.

items.title: 曾经
items.creator: John Carney
items.note: 都柏林街头卖唱者与卖花女的相遇，音乐本身就是他们的爱情信物。
items.noteEn: A busker and a flower-seller in Dublin — the songs are the love story.

items.title: 我在伊朗长大
items.creator: Marjane Satrapi, Vincent Paronnaud
items.note: 黑白漫画自传，在伊斯兰革命与流亡中长成一个女孩倔强的自我。
items.noteEn: A black-and-white comic autobiography — a girl's self forged through revolution and exile.

items.title: 星尘
items.creator: Matthew Vaughn
items.note: 流星坠落的英国童话镇，海盗船长与王子争夺星星。
items.noteEn: A fallen star, a sky pirate and a prince — a cozy British fairy-tale caper.

items.title: 神枪手之死
items.en: The Assassination of Jesse James by the Coward Robert Ford
items.creator: Andrew Dominik
items.note: 罗杰·迪金斯镜头下的黄昏蓝调，把英雄的陨落与懦夫的成名写成互为镜像的悲剧。
items.noteEn: Roger Deakins' twilight-blue study of how a hero's fall and a coward's fame mirror each other.

items.title: 谍影重重3
items.creator: Paul Greengrass
items.note: 手持摄影的晃动美学终结了谍战片的西装雅痞，杰森·伯恩是当代动作语法的转折点。
items.noteEn: Shaky-cam realism killed the tuxedo spy; Jason Bourne is the pivot of modern action grammar.

items.title: 伪钞制造者
items.creator: Stefan Ruzowitzky
items.note: 集中营里被逼伪造英镑的犹太匠人，生存的道德底线在流水线上反复烧灼。
items.noteEn: Jewish forgers forced to print pounds in a camp — survival's ethics burn on the assembly line.

items.title: 血色将至
items.creator: Paul Thomas Anderson
items.note: 石油大亨把贪婪、信仰与父爱全部烧进油井，「我喝光了你的奶昔」是资本主义的墓志铭。
items.noteEn: Daniel's greed consumes faith and fatherhood in the oil fields; "I drink your milkshake" is capitalism's epitaph.

items.title: 十二宫
items.creator: David Fincher
items.note: 用报社编辑的执念还原未破悬案，克制而绵长的数字时代前奏。
items.noteEn: A cartoonist's obsession maps an unsolved case — a patient, procedural pre-internet thriller.

items.title: 入殓师
items.creator: Yōjirō Takita
items.note: 把为逝者整理仪容拍成温柔仪式，入殓师让生者与死者都体面告别。
items.noteEn: Preparing the dead becomes a tender ritual — a way for the living to say farewell with dignity.

items.title: 叶问
items.creator: Wilson Yip
items.note: 甄子丹十连击咏春拳，把一代宗师的儒雅与家国尊严打在银幕上。
items.noteEn: Donnie Yen's ten-hit Wing Chun, projecting the master's poise and national dignity.

items.title: 走钢丝的人
items.creator: James Marsh
items.note: 菲利普·珀蒂偷渡双子塔之间的钢丝，一次关于纯粹之美的完美盗窃。
items.noteEn: Petit's illegal wire-walk between the Twin Towers — a theft of pure beauty, perfectly told.

items.title: 米尔克
items.creator: Gus Van Sant
items.note: 首位公开出柜的民选官员哈维·米尔克，西恩·潘把竞选演讲变成平权宣言。
items.noteEn: Harvey Milk, first openly gay elected official — Penn turns a campaign speech into a rights manifesto.

items.title: 飓风营救
items.creator: Pierre Morel
items.note: 一句'我会找到你'的电话台词，让连姆·尼森成为最优雅的暴怒父亲。
items.noteEn: A single phone line — 'I will find you' — turned Liam Neeson into cinema's most elegant fury.

items.title: 追击者
items.creator: Na Hong-jin
items.note: 皮条客追凶却屡屡擦肩而过，韩国新黑色电影把无力感拧到窒息。
items.noteEn: A pimp hunting a killer he keeps missing — Korean neo-noir tightening helplessness to suffocation.

items.title: 蝙蝠侠：黑暗骑士
items.creator: Christopher Nolan
items.note: 希斯·莱杰的小丑把超级英雄片拖进道德深渊，犯罪戏码比动作更惊心。
items.noteEn: Ledger's Joker drags the superhero film into a moral abyss; the crime beats outshine the action.

items.title: 拆弹部队
items.creator: Kathryn Bigelow
items.note: 拆弹兵的肾上腺素上瘾，伊拉克战场的心理拉锯。
items.noteEn: Bomb-disposal as addiction — the psychology of war in Iraq.

items.title: 机器人总动员
items.creator: Andrew Stanton
items.note: 前四十分钟几乎无对白，垃圾星球上的清洁机器人对着绿色植物心动。
items.noteEn: A trash-compacting robot falls in love with a glance — Pixar's most romantic eco-fable.

items.title: 和巴什尔跳华尔兹
items.creator: Ari Folman
items.note: 动画重建记忆，一名以军士兵直面贝鲁特大屠杀的失忆与罪责。
items.noteEn: Animation as recovered memory — a soldier confronts amnesia and guilt over the Beirut massacre.

items.title: 三傻大闹宝莱坞
items.creator: Rajkumar Hirani
items.note: 「追求卓越，成功自然来」——印度教育体制下三个好友的青春反叛与温情。
items.noteEn: Three friends rebel against rote schooling — Bollywood's anthem for learning with joy.

items.title: 鬼妈妈
items.creator: Henry Selick
items.note: 纽扣眼的另一个妈妈，莱卡的定格动画暗黑魔法。
items.noteEn: A button-eyed Other Mother — Laika's stop-motion dark enchantment.

items.title: 海豚湾
items.creator: Louie Psihoyos
items.note: 卧底镜头潜入日本太地町，血色海湾让人无法移开眼睛。
items.noteEn: Hidden cameras in Taiji's cove — a blood-red bay you cannot look away from.

items.title: 宿醉
items.creator: Todd Phillips
items.note: 婚礼前夜的烂醉狂欢换来一觉醒来丢了新娘子，R 级疯狂喜剧史上最黑的票房黑马。
items.noteEn: A bachelor party blackout that loses the groom — the R-rated comedy that took Vegas by storm.

items.title: 飞屋环游记
items.creator: Pete Docter
items.note: 开头四分钟讲完一生，然后用万千气球把房子拽向天堂瀑布。
items.noteEn: Four minutes to tell a lifetime, then a thousand balloons drag a house to Paradise Falls.

items.title: 怦然心动
items.creator: Rob Reiner
items.note: 一棵梧桐树上的风景，女孩先喜欢再离开——青春心动用双视角讲得又轻又重。
items.noteEn: A sycamore tree, first crushes and shifting perspectives — childhood love told from both sides.

items.title: 盗梦空间
items.creator: Christopher Nolan
items.note: 梦中梦的陀螺永不停转，把潜入梦境的盗贼故事拍成视觉与概念的双重迷宫。
items.noteEn: Dreams within dreams and a spinning top — a heist inside the mind as visual and conceptual maze.

items.title: 让子弹飞
items.creator: 姜文
items.note: 枪声一响、隐喻满场，张麻子与黄四郎的对弈是讲不尽的寓言。
items.noteEn: Bullets flying, allegory everywhere — Zhang's duel with Huang is an inexhaustible fable.

items.title: 禁闭岛
items.creator: Martin Scorsese
items.note: 精神病院的迷宫叙事，真相与幻觉在风暴中的灯塔里对峙。
items.noteEn: A mental-hospital labyrinth — truth and delusion face off in a lighthouse amid the storm.

items.title: 国王的演讲
items.creator: Tom Hooper
items.note: 口吃国王与草根治疗师互相成就，一场演讲治好一个帝国的怯场。
items.noteEn: A stammering king and an unlicensed therapist lift each other; one speech steadies an empire.

items.title: 社交网络
items.creator: David Fincher
items.note: 扎克伯格的背叛与诉讼，芬奇把「改变世界」拍成一场冰冷的智力游戏。
items.noteEn: Zuckerberg's betrayals and lawsuits — Fincher films "changing the world" as a cold mind game.

items.title: 玩具总动员3
items.creator: Lee Unkrich
items.note: 玩具被送进焚化炉的那一幕，是皮克斯对「长大与告别」最重的一笔。
items.noteEn: The toys at the incinerator — Pixar's heaviest statement on growing up and letting go.

items.title: 亡命驾驶
items.creator: Nicolas Winding Refn
items.note: 粉字霓虹下近乎沉默的司机，把复古合成器与暴力反差推到极致。
items.noteEn: A near-silent wheelman under pink neon — synthwave score against bursts of brutality.

items.title: 龙纹身的女孩
items.en: The Girl with the Dragon Tattoo
items.creator: David Fincher
items.note: 黑客少女与记者的北欧悬案联手，冰冷雪原下的家族罪恶被一点点掘开。
items.noteEn: A hacker and a journalist dig into a cold Nordic family's buried crimes.

items.title: 突袭
items.creator: Gareth Evans
items.note: 印尼武打片的一记重拳，把整栋黑帮大楼变成擂台，Pencak Silat 格斗教科书。
items.noteEn: A punch of Indonesian action, turning a gang tower block into a ring — a pencak silat textbook.

items.title: 爱
items.creator: Michael Haneke
items.note: 一对老夫妻直面衰老与死亡的每一帧都克制到残忍，爱到尽头是慈悲也是责任。
items.noteEn: Every frame of an elderly couple facing decay is cruel restraint — love's end is mercy and duty.

items.title: 悲惨世界
items.creator: Tom Hooper
items.note: 全程现场收音的演唱式电影，让雨果的史诗在歌声里翻涌。
items.noteEn: Sung-through and recorded live on set, Hugo's epic surges through song.

items.title: 林肯
items.creator: Steven Spielberg
items.note: 丹尼尔·戴-刘易斯把林肯还原为疲惫的政治博弈者，废除奴隶制是一场幕后的算计与信念。
items.noteEn: DDL's Lincoln is a weary political operator; abolishing slavery is backroom math and conviction.

items.title: 寻找小糖人
items.creator: Malik Bendjelloul
items.note: 底特律歌手在南非成神而他一无所知，查案式纪录片最浪漫的一页。
items.noteEn: A Detroit singer worshipped in South Africa, unaware — investigative documentary at its most romantic.

items.title: 杀戮演绎
items.creator: Joshua Oppenheimer
items.note: 让印尼大屠杀的刽子手重演当年的杀戮，纪录片伦理的极限实验。
items.noteEn: Having Indonesian executioners re-enact their murders — the outer limit of documentary ethics.

items.title: 她
items.creator: Spike Jonze
items.note: 操作系统成了最懂爱的「人」，孤独都市的温柔低语。
items.noteEn: An operating system becomes the most human lover — a tender whisper for lonely cities.

items.title: 囚徒
items.creator: Denis Villeneuve
items.note: 两个女孩失踪引爆小镇的道德崩解，雨夜里的信仰与私刑纠缠。
items.noteEn: Two missing girls crack a town's morality — faith and vigilantism tangled in the rain.

items.title: 一代宗师
items.creator: Wong Kar-wai
items.note: 「见自己、见天地、见众生」，王家卫把咏春宗师叶问拍成一招一式的东方哲学。
items.noteEn: "See self, see heaven and earth, see all beings" — Wong turns Ip Man into moving Eastern philosophy.

items.title: 辉夜姬物语
items.en: The Tale of the Princess Kaguya
items.creator: 高畑勋
items.note: 水墨淡彩的速写长卷，用最老的传说问一个最现代的问题：回月亮还是留在人间。
items.noteEn: A watercolor sketchbook epic asking an ancient question anew: the moon or this world?

items.title: 第四公民
items.creator: Laura Poitras
items.note: 与斯诺登在香港酒店实拍，让观众亲历一场泄密发生的现场。
items.noteEn: Filmed live with Snowden in a Hong Kong hotel — you witness the leak as it happens.

items.title: 机械姬
items.creator: Alex Garland
items.note: 图灵测试的密室反转，Ava 的美与野心令人背脊发凉。
items.noteEn: A chamber-room Turing test where Ava's beauty and guile chill the spine.

items.title: 消失的爱人
items.creator: David Fincher
items.note: 反转婚姻惊悚，把媒体狂欢与性别博弈一层层剥给人看。
items.noteEn: A marriage thriller that flips into a media circus — a scalpel on gender and spectacle.

items.title: 星际穿越
items.creator: Christopher Nolan
items.note: 黑洞、五维书架与麦田，父女情跨越引力与时间。
items.noteEn: A black hole, a tesseract and a father-daughter bond spanning gravity and time.

items.title: 疾速追杀
items.creator: Chad Stahelski
items.note: 为一条狗复仇的退役杀手，以枪斗术和霓虹美学重造了动作片的节奏感。
items.noteEn: A retired hitman avenging his dog, redefining action rhythm with gun-fu and neon style.

items.title: 夜行者
items.creator: Dan Gilroy
items.note: 把新闻底线熬成商业野心的吉伦哈尔，病态魅力照出现代媒体的镜像。
items.noteEn: Gyllenhaal's sociopath selling blood-soaked footage — a mirror held to modern media.

items.title: 海洋之歌
items.creator: Tomm Moore
items.note: 凯尔特神话里的海豹精与即将消亡的传说，几何装饰风的美术教科书。
items.noteEn: A selkie and a dying mythology — a textbook of geometric, decorative animation.

items.title: 鬼书
items.creator: Jennifer Kent
items.note: 绘本怪物与丧夫创伤，把恐惧拍成单亲妈妈的战争。
items.noteEn: A pop-up monster born of grief — one mother's war against the dark.

items.title: 模仿游戏
items.creator: Morten Tyldum
items.note: 图灵破译恩尼格玛的秘密战争，与一个天才被时代辜负的悲剧。
items.noteEn: Turing's secret war against Enigma — and a genius betrayed by the very system he saved.

items.title: 万物理论
items.creator: James Marsh
items.note: 霍金的宇宙理论之外，是简·霍金在病床边的坚守，时间对爱情同样无情。
items.noteEn: Beyond Hawking's cosmos is Jane's vigil at his bedside — time is as cruel to love as to stars.

items.title: 荒蛮故事
items.creator: Damián Szifrón
items.note: 六个失控的复仇小故事，从婚礼到公路，文明随时准备被撕成碎片。
items.noteEn: Six stories of rage snapping — from wedding to highway, civilization is a bomb waiting to go off.

items.title: 艾米
items.creator: Asif Kapadia
items.note: 用家庭录像拼出艾米·怀恩豪斯的一生，成名与毁灭同步发生。
items.noteEn: Family tapes reassembling Amy Winehouse's life — fame and ruin arriving together.

items.title: 失常
items.creator: Charlie Kaufman, Duke Johnson
items.note: 定格动画拍中年男人在千人一面的世界里，撞见唯一不同的声音。
items.noteEn: Stop-motion for a midlife man who, in a world of identical faces, meets one unique voice.

items.title: 头脑特工队
items.creator: Pete Docter
items.note: 把情绪做成五个小人，告诉你悲伤其实是成长真正的燃料。
items.noteEn: Emotions as five little people — sadness turns out to be the real fuel of growing up.

items.title: 疯狂的麦克斯4：狂暴之路
items.creator: George Miller
items.note: 两小时不间断的沙漠追车芭蕾，实拍特效的极致，反乌托邦的女性主义寓言。
items.noteEn: Two hours of non-stop desert chase ballet, practical effects at their peak, a feminist dystopian fable.

items.title: 边境杀手
items.creator: Denis Villeneuve
items.note: 美墨边境的灰色地带，'墙'上开出的不是正义而是纪律化的邪恶。
items.noteEn: The moral grey of the border — the 'wall' grows disciplined evil, not justice.

items.title: 火星救援
items.creator: Ridley Scott
items.note: 用科学与幽默在火星自救，NASA 自救手册的电影版。
items.noteEn: MacGyvering survival on Mars with science and wisecracks.

items.title: 女巫
items.creator: Robert Eggers
items.note: 新英格兰清教徒家庭的信仰崩塌，「魔鬼就在树林里」。
items.noteEn: A Puritan family's faith unravels — the devil is real in the wood.

items.title: 第十三修正案
items.creator: Ava DuVernay
items.note: 从宪法第十三修正案的漏洞，追踪美国监狱工业的百年闭环。
items.noteEn: From the 13th Amendment's loophole to America's prison-industrial century.

items.title: 降临
items.creator: Denis Villeneuve
items.note: 语言学家用非线性时间观改写第一类接触。
items.noteEn: A linguist redefines first contact through a non-linear view of time.

items.title: 摔跤吧！爸爸
items.creator: Nitesh Tiwari
items.note: 阿米尔·汗把女儿们训练成摔跤冠军，一位父亲替她们对抗整个世界，直到她们能自己选择。
items.noteEn: Aamir Khan turns daughters into wrestlers — a father fights the world so they can choose their own.

items.title: 海上火焰
items.creator: Gianfranco Rosi
items.note: 兰佩杜萨岛的孩童日常与难民船并置，罕见的纪录长片金熊奖得主。
items.noteEn: A child's routine on Lampedusa against refugee boats — a rare documentary Golden Bear.

items.title: 血战钢锯岭
items.creator: Mel Gibson
items.note: 拒绝持枪的军医戴斯蒙德在冲绳救下七十五条命，信仰可以是一个人的战争。
items.noteEn: A medic who refuses to bear arms saves 75 lives on Okinawa — faith can fight a one-man war.

items.title: 隐藏人物
items.creator: Theodore Melfi
items.note: 三位黑人女数学家把人类送上轨道，办公室里的种族隔离比太空更远。
items.noteEn: Three Black women mathematicians put humans in orbit — office segregation farther than space.

items.title: 爱乐之城
items.creator: Damien Chazelle
items.note: 洛杉矶追梦者的爵士与霓虹，结尾那段蒙太奇是写给错过的挽歌。
items.noteEn: Dreamers, jazz and LA neon — a final montage that mourns the road not taken.

items.title: 海边的曼彻斯特
items.creator: Kenneth Lonergan
items.note: 失去孩子的父亲拒绝和解，悲伤不一定要被治愈——它只是被携带着活下去。
items.noteEn: A grieving father refuses closure; sorrow need not heal — only be carried on.

items.title: 月光男孩
items.creator: Barry Jenkins
items.note: 三段式描摹黑人男孩的成长、身份与爱，海边的蓝是温柔也是枷锁。
items.noteEn: Three acts of a Black boy's coming of age — the blue by the sea is both tenderness and a cage.

items.title: 西葫芦的生活
items.creator: Claude Barras
items.note: 定格黏土孤儿院，把儿童眼中的创伤拍得既明亮又疼痛。
items.noteEn: Claymation in a children's home — trauma seen through a child's bright, hurting eyes.

items.title: 红海龟
items.creator: Michael Dudok de Wit
items.note: 吉卜力监制的无对白寓言，一个人与一只红龟在荒岛上的半生轮回。
items.noteEn: A dialogue-free fable produced by Studio Ghibli — one man, one turtle, a lifetime on an island.

items.title: 哭声
items.creator: Na Hong-jin
items.note: 韩国山村驱魔疑云，邪灵与病毒纠缠的多义恐怖。
items.noteEn: A Korean village, a shaman and a demon — ambiguity as dread.

items.title: 釜山行
items.creator: Yeon Sang-ho
items.note: 丧尸列车的封闭空间逃杀，韩影工业的类型爆发。
items.noteEn: A zombie outbreak on a Seoul-bound train — K-horror at full throttle.

items.title: 你的名字。
items.creator: 新海诚
items.note: 互换身体的少男少女隔着时间与灾厄寻找彼此，新海诚美学的全球爆点。
items.noteEn: Body-swapping teens search for each other across time and disaster — Shinkai's global breakthrough.

items.title: 出租车司机
items.creator: Jang Hoon
items.note: 光州事件的目击者：首尔出租车司机误闯戒严现场，一个人用方向盘载起一段历史。
items.noteEn: A Seoul taxi driver stumbles into the Gwangju crackdown — one wheeled witness carries history.

items.title: 极盗车神
items.creator: Edgar Wright
items.note: 追逐戏与流行金曲精准卡拍的音画同步，让汽车追逐有了节奏与乐感。
items.noteEn: Chases choreographed to pop tunes — car chases finally have rhythm and pitch.

items.title: 银翼杀手2049
items.creator: Denis Villeneuve
items.note: 延续原作的存在主义追问，橙灰两色的末日摄影拿下奥斯卡。
items.noteEn: The existential question continues — its burnt-orange cinematography earned an Oscar.

items.title: 至暗时刻
items.creator: Joe Wright
items.note: 加里·奥德曼的丘吉尔，把嘴硬、焦虑与绝不投降揉进每一次呼吸。
items.noteEn: Gary Oldman's Churchill — stubbornness, anxiety and refusal to yield in every breath.

items.title: 敦刻尔克
items.creator: Christopher Nolan
items.note: 陆海空三线交叉剪辑的敦刻尔克撤退，时间本身就是敌人。
items.noteEn: Three timelines converge on the beach — time itself is the enemy.

items.title: 脸庞，村庄
items.creator: Agnès Varda, JR
items.note: 八十九岁的瓦尔达与三十三岁的 JR 开着卡车巡游法国，把巨幅肖像贴满村庄。
items.noteEn: An eighty-nine-year-old Varda and thirty-three-year-old JR plaster giant portraits across French villages.

items.title: 逃出绝命镇
items.creator: Jordan Peele
items.note: 黑人体检变器官移植，把种族议题装进惊悚容器。
items.noteEn: A liberal getaway that hides body-snatching — race as horror.

items.title: 水形物语
items.creator: Guillermo del Toro
items.note: 清洁女工与水池怪物的跨物种之恋，冷战灰暗年代里最温柔的童话。
items.noteEn: A cleaner and an amphibian creature fall in love — a fairy tale inside the Cold War.

items.title: 一个明星的诞生
items.creator: Bradley Cooper
items.note: 巨星陨落与新人升起同框，「Shallow」把爱情与才华的代价唱进骨头里。
items.noteEn: A legend fades as a star rises — 'Shallow' cuts to the bone of love and fame.

items.title: 波西米亚狂想曲
items.creator: Bryan Singer
items.note: 拉米·马雷克在 Live Aid 舞台上复刻皇后乐队，弗雷迪的璀璨与孤独同频共振。
items.noteEn: Rami Malek relives Queen at Live Aid — Freddie's brilliance and loneliness resonate as one.

items.title: 燃烧
items.creator: Lee Chang-dong
items.note: 消失的女孩与温室之谜，李沧东把村上春树的短篇改写成当代韩国的愤怒与虚无。
items.noteEn: A missing girl and vanishing greenhouses — Lee turns Murakami's short story into Korean rage and void.

items.title: 冷战
items.creator: Paweł Pawlikowski
items.note: 铁幕两侧分合二十年的恋人，黑白胶片与一首歌贯穿冷战年代的流亡。
items.noteEn: Lovers split and reunite across the Iron Curtain; a song threads through two decades of exile.

items.title: 徒手攀岩
items.creator: Elizabeth Chai Vasarhelyi, Jimmy Chin
items.note: 无保护攀登酋长岩，镜头的每一次靠近都让人手心出汗。
items.noteEn: Climbing El Capitan without ropes — every camera move makes you sweat with him.

items.title: 遗传厄运
items.creator: Ari Aster
items.note: 家族遗传的创伤与邪教，被视作「现代恐怖已死」的回应。
items.noteEn: Grief and a cult conspiracy run in the blood — a new horror benchmark.

items.title: 碟中谍6：全面瓦解
items.creator: Christopher McQuarrie
items.note: 阿汤哥亲自跳直升机与 HALO 跳伞，实拍特技堆出好莱坞最后的奇观主义。
items.noteEn: Cruise really jumps from a helicopter and free-falls in HALO — practical stunts as final spectacle.

items.title: 罗马
items.creator: Alfonso Cuarón
items.note: 黑白镜头凝视墨西哥城一个中产家庭与女佣，卡隆把私人记忆拍成时代的涟漪。
items.noteEn: A monochrome gaze on a Mexico City household and its maid — Cuarón turns memory into an era's ripple.

items.title: 小偷家族
items.creator: Hirokazu Kore-eda
items.note: 没有血缘的一家人靠偷窃维生，却比许多家庭更接近「家」的定义。
items.noteEn: A family bound not by blood but by shoplifting — closer to "family" than most real ones.

items.title: 蜘蛛侠：平行宇宙
items.creator: Bob Persichetti, Peter Ramsey, Rodney Rothman
items.note: 漫画半色调、破格分镜、六位蜘蛛侠同框，把纸页质感炸进了银幕。
items.noteEn: Halftone dots, broken panels, six Spider-People — comic-page texture detonated on screen.

items.title: 巴斯特·斯克鲁格斯的歌谣
items.creator: Joel & Ethan Coen
items.note: 六个风格迥异的西部短篇，科恩兄弟把死亡与荒诞嵌进明信片般的风景。
items.noteEn: Six very different tales of the frontier — the Coens frame death and absurdity beautifully.

items.creator: Sam Mendes
items.note: 一镜到底穿越战壕送信，把一战拍成实时炼狱。
items.noteEn: A continuous single-shot dash across No Man's Land — WWI in real time.

items.title: 仲夏夜惊魂
items.creator: Ari Aster
items.note: 白昼永昼下的瑞典祭祀，分手电影变成民俗噩梦。
items.noteEn: Sunlit pagan rites turn a breakup into a folk-horror nightmare.

items.title: 哪吒之魔童降世
items.creator: 饺子
items.note: 魔童设定重写「我命由我不由天」，一举打破中国动画的票房天花板。
items.noteEn: 'My fate is mine to decide' — a reimagined Nezha that broke China's animation box-office records.

items.title: 寄生虫
items.creator: Bong Joon-ho
items.note: 地下室与豪宅之间只隔一段楼梯，奉俊昊的阶级寓言在暴雨夜轰然崩塌。
items.noteEn: A basement and a mansion, one staircase apart — Bong's class fable collapses on a stormy night.

items.title: 罗小黑战记
items.creator: MTJJ
items.note: 治愈系小黑猫流落人间，把国漫的利落打斗与温柔日常揉进同一帧。
items.noteEn: A healing black cat adrift among humans, blending crisp Chinese-style action with quiet warmth.

items.title: 夺冠
items.creator: Peter Chan
items.note: 从女排五连冠到里约重夺金，郎平与女排姑娘们把「女排精神」压进每一个扣杀。
items.noteEn: From five straight titles to Rio's gold — Lang Ping and her team pack "volleyball spirit" into every spike.

items.title: 我的章鱼老师
items.creator: Pippa Ehrlich, James Reed
items.note: 潜水员与一只章鱼的跨物种友谊，把海底拍成最温柔的相遇。
items.noteEn: A diver and an octopus's cross-species friendship — the gentlest encounter under the sea.

items.title: 狼行者
items.creator: Tomm Moore, Ross Stewart
items.note: 十七世纪爱尔兰的森林魔法，手绘线条里藏着对殖民与压制的隐喻。
items.noteEn: Woodland magic in seventeenth-century Ireland, with colonialism hidden in the hand-drawn lines.

items.title: 沙丘
items.creator: Denis Villeneuve
items.note: 沙丘美学与巨型尺度，维伦纽瓦把厄拉科斯拍成神迹。
items.noteEn: Desert colossalism — Villeneuve's awe-scale adaptation of Herbert's epic.

items.title: 灵魂乐之夏
items.creator: Questlove
items.note: 尘封五十年的哈莱姆文化节影像重见天日，一场被遗忘的黑人音乐盛典。
items.noteEn: Harlem's lost festival footage resurfaces after fifty years — a forgotten Black music celebration.

items.title: 绿衣骑士
items.creator: David Lowery
items.note: 高文骑士的绿林试炼，亚瑟王传说的仪式化改编。
items.noteEn: Gawain's chivalric trial reimagined as a slow, ritualistic fable.

items.title: 西线无战事（2022）
items.en: All Quiet on the Western Front (2022)
items.creator: Edward Berger
items.note: 新版把战争拍成绞肉机，获最佳国际影片等三项奥斯卡。
items.noteEn: The 2022 retelling renders war as a meat-grinder, winning Best International Feature.

items.title: 瞬息全宇宙
items.creator: Daniel Kwan & Daniel Scheinert
items.note: 用多元宇宙的疯狂想象讲华裔母亲的母女关系，报税单上的家庭也能拯救所有宇宙。
items.noteEn: Multiverse madness as a Chinese-American mother-daughter story — even a laundromat family saves every universe.

items.title: 壮志凌云2：独行侠
items.creator: Joseph Kosinski
items.note: 实拍 F-18 驾驶舱与 IMAX 空战，让三十五年后的续集比前作更酣畅。
items.noteEn: Real F-18 cockpits and IMAX dogfights make the 35-years-later sequel out-fly its original.

items.title: 奥本海默
items.creator: Christopher Nolan
items.note: 「现在我成了死神」，诺兰用 IMAX 与黑白听证会拆解原子弹之父的道德十字架。
items.noteEn: "Now I am become Death" — Nolan's IMAX hearings dissect the father of the bomb's moral cross.
